resources.string: Record timer log on this phone

Only time spent in selected apps uses your break. Other apps and screen-off time do not count. The notification refreshes about every 5 seconds.\n\nThis log keeps the last 240 checks on your phone. It contains times and counters, with no app names, screen contents or keys. You can turn recording off or clear the log. Export saves a file only where you choose; nothing is uploaded automatically.
